actions: Separated the existing decision-only intersection-union gate from the distinct simultaneous numeric-bound reporting contract.
Implemented a four-stream wrapper: decision equal/exposure at alpha .05 and reporting equal/exposure at precommitted .025/.025.
Bound all four streams to the exact same canonical closed-row history and deterministic row digest for replay identity.
Ran 500 synthetic contract-validation trajectories of horizon 2000 with predictable exposure weights.
Persisted implementation, validation script/results, checkpoint, and advanced role-local LATEST by CAS after confirming no competing evaluation advance.
scope_warning: Stopping-time values come from a validation-only weighted Hoeffding/fixed-lambda family, not the production V3 water-filling implementation. They validate wiring and contract separation only.
exact_next_action: Connect the new wrapper to the actual production V3 predictable-weight stream factory and replay the canonical journal history, requiring identical decision-IUT outputs while measuring V3-specific simultaneous-bound widening and stopping delay.
